```{r tippelapper}
spmtab <- tibble(spm="Klubblaget ditt",
                   tekst="",
                   poeng=NA) |> 
  bind_rows(alle_spm |> 
              distinct())
# |> 
  # flextable::flextable() |> 
  # flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")

svartab <- bind_rows(alle_svar|> 
            filter(id!="Fasit") ,
          metadata |> 
            filter(id!="Fasit") |> 
            select(id, svar = klubblaget_ditt) |> 
            mutate(spm = "Klubblaget ditt")) |> 
  left_join(metadata |> select(autograf,id), by = join_by(id)) |> 
  select(-id) |> 
pivot_wider(names_from=autograf, values_from=svar) 
# |>
  # flextable::flextable() |> 
  # flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")

spmtab |> left_join(svartab) |>
  # arrange(spm) |> 
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit") |> 
  flextable::font(fontname="Arial",part="all")
```
